Card Q&A.q: Does this card's inherited effect also trigger when one of my opponent's effects plays my Digimon?

When a [Dobermon] with [BT10-011 Canoweissmon] and [Gammamon] with an [On Play] effect in its digivolution cards digivolves into this card, does this card's [When Digivolving] effect activate the [On Play] effect on both this card and the [Gammamon] digivolution card?

Effect: [On Play] 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Retaliation＞ until the end of your opponent's turn.
[When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞. Then, trash 1 card in your hand. If [Dobermon] or [X Antibody] is in this Digimon's digivolution cards, activate this Digimon's [On Play] effects.
Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When an effect plays one of your Digimon, gain 1 memory.
